methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.

actual_scope: Classify simultaneous scalar helper/snapshot basis changes at one live ERASE cut for arbitrary nonzero linear snapshot operators over F2.
scope_change_reason: The proposed D-prefix feedback scope is already covered by PR1306/1557/1706. This bounded pivot treats a live COPY cut with transformed original centers and snapshots, rather than D H2/K.
bottleneck_link: A necessary interface screen for an attempted helper-mixing escape from the live-COPY stabilizer; no profile or supplier gain.
stop_rule: Prove the exact operator condition and test all two-role nonzero 2x2 operators before any physical mechanism search.
evidence: Operator intertwining theorem and equal-operator block classification; 8100 complete two-role cases and 141120 three-role cases, literal dirty-input verification, exact paid toy schedule and rejecting false covariance control.
